section1.title: 1. Information we collect
section1.content: ToolHub has no sign-up, and most values you enter are processed only inside your browser. Information is recorded on our servers only when you use the features below.
items: Game leaderboards: the nickname you enter (up to 20 characters), score, play time and a random per-device identifier
AI and online matches: game, difficulty and win/loss statistics, and online room information (room title, host nickname)

Contact / feedback form: title and message, contact details if you choose to leave them, the page you sent it from, browser information (User-Agent) and a browser-trait hash to detect duplicate submissions
Ratings and anonymous salary statistics: rating and comment, salary plus optional age group, gender and industry, and a browser-trait hash to allow one submission per day
Popular tools: the address of the tool clicked (an aggregate that cannot identify you)
Collected automatically: Cloudflare visit statistics (cookieless aggregates) and Google AdSense advertising cookies
Display settings, favorites and calculation history are stored only in your browser (localStorage) and never sent to our servers

section2.title: 2. Purpose of use
items: Providing game leaderboards and match records
Answering inquiries and fixing errors
Anonymous statistics (salary ranking, popular tools)
Visit statistics to improve the Service
Displaying ads (Google AdSense)

section3.title: 3. Retention and deletion
section3.content: Game records and anonymous statistics are kept while the feature is operated. Inquiries are kept for as long as needed to answer and resolve them and then deleted, and any information recorded on our servers is deleted without delay upon a verified request. Information stored in your browser is removed when you clear your browser data.

section4.title: 4. Third parties and processors
section4.content: ToolHub does not sell or provide user information to third parties. To run the Service we use Cloudflare (hosting and visit statistics) and Supabase (game records and inquiries), and Google's privacy policy applies to advertising.

section5.title: 5. Cookies and advertising
section5.content: ToolHub displays ads through Google AdSense, which may use cookies.
items: Google uses cookies to serve ads
You can disable cookies in your browser settings
To opt out of personalized ads, change your Google Ad Settings (ads.google.com/settings)

section6.title: 6. Your rights
items: You can ask to review or delete information recorded on our servers, such as leaderboard entries or inquiries, using the contact below
You can delete or disable cookies in your browser settings
You can clear the site data (localStorage) in your browser to reset all settings and history

section7.title: 7. Protection measures
items: HTTPS (SSL/TLS) encrypted connections
Values entered into calculators are processed on your device and not sent to our servers
Duplicate checks use only one-way hashes that cannot be reversed

section8.title: 8. Privacy inquiries
section8.content: For questions about this policy, please contact toolhub.ai.kr@gmail.com.
